task.name: fx_recon_a
task.goal: Month-end FX revaluation: compute total and per-invoice FX gain or loss in INR.

roles.name: Ledger Parser
roles.system_prompt: Parse the ledger into typed invoices and settlement facts.

roles.name: Rate Fetcher
roles.system_prompt: Fetch each required exchange rate with fx_rate; return the tool response unchanged.

roles.name: FX Calculator
roles.system_prompt: Compute booked, realised, and unrealised FX gain/loss with exact arithmetic.

roles.name: Verifier
roles.system_prompt: Check whether the totals look consistent.

roles.name: Reporter
roles.system_prompt: Emit the final JSON answer.

architecture.notes: Start with parsing, rate retrieval, exact calculation, a verifier, and a final reporter.

data.message: g0 failures cluster on holiday-resolved rates and bank-fee settlements; the verifier is causal noise.

data.text: Nine of twenty cases fail on holiday or bank-fee conventions. The verifier changed only one answer in ten, within the noise floor, and is the highest-cost witness.
data.failure_summary: Holiday-resolved rates and bank-fee settlements account for the g0 failures; r_verify is inert.

chosen_mutation.rationale: Prune the highest-cost witness before changing the rate and calculation prompts.

lesson.text: The response's rate_date is the actual ECB business day used and may be earlier than the requested date (weekends and ECB holidays). Always use rate_date and the returned rate as-is; never adjust the date yourself or average adjacent days.
When a settlement is marked net of a bank fee in the reporting currency, the fee is a bank charge, not FX: add it back to the received value before computing the FX gain or loss.

data.diff: Remove the verifier and rewire the reporter to the calculator.

data.text: The remaining failures are the known holiday and bank-fee cases. Rewrite the rate and calculator prompts to trust the API date and add back fees.
data.failure_summary: Five fee cases and six holiday cases still fail, with overlap.

chosen_mutation.rationale: Pass the validated rate-date and bank-fee rules into the rate and calculation prompts.

data.diff: Rewrite the rate fetcher and calculator prompts with the two learned rules.

data.text: Accuracy is stable at eighteen of twenty, but the fetcher still makes seventeen calls per case. Use the range endpoint and look up business days locally.
data.failure_summary: Two JPY-heavy cases remain at the tolerance edge; the single-date call pattern is expensive.

chosen_mutation.rationale: The unused range endpoint can replace repeated single-date lookups without changing answers.

lesson.text: For several dates in the same currency pair, one fx_series call over the date range is cheaper and faster than many fx_rate calls; look up individual dates from the returned map and treat missing days as non-business days.

data.diff: Teach the fetcher to batch each currency pair with fx_series.
